info.name: GnozaAI API
info.description:
GnozaAI backend: personalized news and events aggregation, content clustering, AI-powered analysis and chat, trending articles, and nearby events.

Auth: JWT Bearer tokens. Run **Auth > Login** first (or Register + Activate Account) — it auto-saves `access_token`/`refresh_token` as collection variables used by every other request. When the access token expires, run **Auth > Refresh Token**.

Response envelope for most endpoints: `{status_code, success, message, data}`. List/browse endpoints under Content/Feed/Topics content use DRF's paginated shape: `{count, next, previous, results}`.
